market_question: Will Gretchen Whitmer win the 2028 Democratic presidential nomination?
reasoning: Gretchen Whitmer is a two-term governor of Michigan, a critical swing state, with national profile and fundraising capacity. She will be term-limited out of office in January 2027, perfectly timed for a 2028 run. While the field is wide open and she is not a prohibitive favorite, her true chances are likely well above the market's 1.1% implied probability; I estimate around 5%.
evidence_points: Term-limited Michigan governor leaves office in Jan 2027, free to campaign full-time.
Strong national name recognition from COVID-19 response, re-election, and 2020 VP shortlist.
2028 primary speculation consistently includes her among top-tier potential candidates.
